CONTROL: Resonant imagines a New York twisted by the power of the enigmatic Hiss. This interdimensional force corrupts everything it touches, and all the iconic touchstones of New York are no exception; subway stations, pizza joints, and coffee shops are all filtered through the Hiss’s malevolent power. 

Of course, it wouldn’t be New York without its fair share of billboards, too. But these are no ordinary advertisements; the Hiss (and by proxy, those mad geniuses at Remedy Entertainment) had a ton of fun warping every day ad designs into mindbending, brain-breaking images. iam8bit adores these creative concoctions. So we’ve immortalized them for you here. 

This is the CONTROL Resonant: Billboard Bumper Stickers Pack. This set of 4 adhesive bumper stickers features designs straight from the game itself, rendered in all their glory. They come in FBC-Approved custom Containment Wrapping, too, to make the whole experience feel all the more official. Whether you’re decorating your laptop or just trying to weird out the next person bold enough to tailgate you, these stickers are sure to do the trick.

Persona 5 has stolen the hearts of millions of fans across the globe. The critically-acclaimed JRPG is so beloved, in fact, that it’s practically a franchise in its own right: Spin-Offs, the enhanced edition Royal, an anime special, stage plays, guest appearances in other games, and more all help shape the legend that is Persona 5. It remains one of the watershed moments of its console generation. 

Now, iam8bit and Atlus are joining forces to honor the legend of Persona 5 once again. This is the Persona 5 Essentials - Cassette Soundtrack! Its release marks the first time the music has ever been available on cassette. Songs like “The Whims of Fate,” “Life Will Change,” and of course, “Last Surprise” have been mastered for the format for the very first time ever.

products.body_html:

“The Persona 5 soundtrack makes every day feel cool” - The Verge

It’s back.

Persona 5 is a massive and epic opus of a game - the kind of 100-hour-plus JRPG journey that it is impossible to peel away from.

The soundtrack is equally epic, featuring hours of jazzy, poppy, energetic musical magic that you’ll find yourself unconsciously whistling throughout the day. From upbeat vocally-driven songs (many featuring the incomparable throaty gusto of Japanese soul singer, Lyn Inaizumi) to more contemplative, instrumental riffs, Atlus Sound Team assembled an impressive ensemble of tunes.

Quite simply, Persona 5 is one of iam8bit’s favorite video game soundtracks to date.

Now, together with Atlus, we’re reissuing one of our most popular, in-demand, frothed-at-the-mouth-for releases ever. This is the Persona 5 Vinyl Soundtrack - The Deluxe Edition 6xLP Reissue!

It’s the complete Persona 5 soundtrack, spread across 6 gorgeous, classic black vinyl discs, each with their own unique center label. The original album art from Drew Wise is back, too, in all its glory, complete with the special inner sleeves made to match Persona 5’s beloved cast. 

If you missed this crown jewel last time, now’s your chance to get it — but act fast. This special reissue is only available in limited quantities, built to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Persona 5. Don’t miss out.

Media Molecule’s LittleBigPlanet was, and remains, dramatically ahead of its time. A puzzle platformer that emphasized user-generated content and cooperative play, LittleBigPlanet embodied a spirit of player-driven creativity that has come to define the current generation of smash-hit games. 

Perhaps the most impressive thing about LittleBigPlanet was the way it managed to make such a big, robust gameplay concept feel so dang cozy and warm. Its textile-inspired textures and dulcet narration, courtesy of Stephen Fry, granted the game an unmistakable crafty charm. Creation, it seemed to insist, should be satisfying, uncomplicated, and fun.

That spirit is alive and well in the game’s unforgettable soundtrack. Composers Mat Clark and Kenneth C M Young stitched together a soundtrack that draws inspirations from world music, family-friendly nursery rhymes, groovy blended mashups, and beyond. iam8bit has always felt inspired by LittleBigPlanet’s undeniable pizzazz. That’s why we’re pleased as punch to team up with Sony Interactive Entertainment to bring it to vinyl. 

The LittleBigPlanet CD, much like its inspiration’s protagonist, packs a big punch from within a little package. On its two discs you’ll find 15 hand-selected tracks from the game, covering a delicious sampling platter of its rich cornucopia of moods. The album art, from illustrator Haley bbanditt Wakefield, celebrates the collage of muses that make LittleBigPlanet such a joy to experience. The result is an album that’s a true celebration of not just games, but creativity itself.

A good spinoff lifts from its inspirations; a great spinoff dares to be a little different. Sackboy: A Big Adventure certainly falls into the latter camp. Developer Sumo Digital took the already refined platforming core of LittleBigPlanet and spun it into a lovable, family-friendly romp through a colorful and imaginative world. 

Winner of Best British Game and Best Family Game at the 2021 British Academy Games Awards, much of Sackboy’s distinctly English charm came from its warm, welcoming aesthetic — and, crucially, its equally warm and welcoming soundtrack. 

Sackboy’s soundtrack is a hummable, whimsical sonic odyssey packed toe to tip with delightful covers and lovely original compositions alike. It’s more than worthy of the vinyl treatment, so iam8bit is honored to team up with Sony Interactive Entertainment to immortalize it here for you. 

This is the Sackboy: A Big Adventure 2xLP. On its two discs, pressed on groovy Dreamer Orb Vinyl, you’ll find twenty tracks covering the whole dang adventure, from title theme to “The Final Showdown” and beyond. 

The album art is something to behold, too: Illustrator Haley bbanditt Wakefield crafted (get it?) cover art that captures Sackboy’s intrepid tiny-guy-in-a-big-world attitude. Inside, you’ll find a clever collage that actually forms a musical ledger in the shape of the game’s recurring musical riff. It’s a sweet way to acknowledge how integral music really is to Sackboy’s solo outing.

Media Molecule’s LittleBigPlanet was, and remains, dramatically ahead of its time. A puzzle platformer that emphasized user-generated content and cooperative play, LittleBigPlanet embodied a spirit of player-driven creativity that has come to define the current generation of smash-hit games. 

Perhaps the most impressive thing about LittleBigPlanet was the way it managed to make such a big, robust gameplay concept feel so dang cozy and warm. Its textile-inspired textures and dulcet narration, courtesy of Stephen Fry, granted the game an unmistakable crafty charm. Creation, it seemed to insist, should be satisfying, uncomplicated, and fun.

That spirit is alive and well in the game’s unforgettable soundtrack. Composers Mat Clark and Kenneth C M Young stitched together a soundtrack that draws inspirations from world music, family-friendly nursery rhymes, groovy blended mashups, and beyond. iam8bit has always felt inspired by LittleBigPlanet’s undeniable pizzazz. That’s why we’re pleased as punch to team up with Sony Interactive Entertainment to bring it to vinyl. 

The LittleBigPlanet 2xLP, much like its inspiration’s protagonist, packs a big punch in a little package. On its four sides you’ll find 15 hand-selected tracks from the game, covering a delicious sampling platter of its rich cornucopia of moods. It’s pressed on Earth & Moon Inspired Vinyl, two gorgeous disparate but complementary vinyl shades made to match the all-new album art from Haley bbanditt Wakefield. The illustrations inside celebrate the collage of muses that make LittleBigPlanet such a joy to experience. The result is an album that’s a true celebration of not just games, but creativity itself.
